title: LLM Message Handling & Translation
summary: This module provides core functionalities for handling and translating messages between various LLM provider formats and LangChain's internal content block representation. It also includes utilities for message manipulation, filtering, and token-based truncation.

nodes.label: Register All Translators
nodes.title: Register Translators
nodes.description: Initializes and registers all available message block translators for different LLM providers within the LangChain Core system.

nodes.label: Translate Anthropic Message
nodes.title: Anthropic Message Translation
nodes.description: Converts a full Anthropic AI message into a list of standard LangChain content blocks.

nodes.label: Translate Anthropic Chunk
nodes.title: Anthropic Chunk Translation
nodes.description: Converts an Anthropic AI message chunk into a list of standard LangChain content blocks, typically used in streaming scenarios.

nodes.label: Iterate Anthropic Blocks
nodes.title: Anthropic Block Iterator
nodes.description: Internal iterator that processes raw Anthropic content blocks and yields them as standard LangChain content block types, handling tool calls, reasoning, and citations.

nodes.label: Translate Bedrock Message
nodes.title: Bedrock Message Translation
nodes.description: Converts a full Bedrock AI message into a list of standard LangChain content blocks, with specific handling for Claude models.

nodes.label: Translate Bedrock Chunk
nodes.title: Bedrock Chunk Translation
nodes.description: Converts a Bedrock AI message chunk into a list of standard LangChain content blocks, primarily for streaming.

nodes.label: Iterate Bedrock Converse Blocks
nodes.title: Bedrock Converse Block Iterator
nodes.description: Internal iterator that processes raw Bedrock Converse content blocks and yields them as standard LangChain content block types, including text, reasoning, and tool use.

nodes.label: Translate Google GenAI Message
nodes.title: Google GenAI Message Translation
nodes.description: Converts a full Google GenAI message into a list of standard LangChain content blocks.

nodes.label: Translate Google GenAI Chunk
nodes.title: Google GenAI Chunk Translation
nodes.description: Converts a Google GenAI message chunk into a list of standard LangChain content blocks, for streaming.

nodes.label: Translate Groq Message
nodes.title: Groq Message Translation
nodes.description: Converts a full Groq AI message into a list of standard LangChain content blocks.

nodes.label: Translate Groq Chunk
nodes.title: Groq Chunk Translation
nodes.description: Converts a Groq AI message chunk into a list of standard LangChain content blocks, for streaming.

nodes.label: Translate OpenAI Message
nodes.title: OpenAI Message Translation
nodes.description: Converts a full OpenAI AI message into a list of standard LangChain content blocks, handling different content formats.

nodes.label: Translate OpenAI Chunk
nodes.title: OpenAI Chunk Translation
nodes.description: Converts an OpenAI AI message chunk into a list of standard LangChain content blocks, for streaming.

nodes.label: Iterate OpenAI Blocks
nodes.title: OpenAI Block Iterator
nodes.description: Internal iterator that processes raw OpenAI content blocks and yields them as standard LangChain content block types, including text, image generation, function calls, and server tool calls.

nodes.label: Convert OpenAI Chat Input
nodes.title: OpenAI Chat Input Conversion
nodes.description: Converts OpenAI Chat Completions API input blocks (e.g., image_url, file) into standard LangChain v1 content blocks.

nodes.label: Create Text Block
nodes.title: Text Content Block Factory
nodes.description: Generates a standard 'TextContentBlock' with optional ID, annotations, and index.

nodes.label: Create Image Block
nodes.title: Image Content Block Factory
nodes.description: Generates an 'ImageContentBlock' from a URL, base64 data, or file ID, with optional MIME type and ID.

nodes.label: Create Video Block
nodes.title: Video Content Block Factory
nodes.description: Generates a 'VideoContentBlock' from a URL, base64 data, or file ID, with optional MIME type and ID.

nodes.label: Create Audio Block
nodes.title: Audio Content Block Factory
nodes.description: Generates an 'AudioContentBlock' from a URL, base64 data, or file ID, with optional MIME type and ID.

nodes.label: Create File Block
nodes.title: File Content Block Factory
nodes.description: Generates a 'FileContentBlock' from a URL, base64 data, or file ID, with optional MIME type and ID.

nodes.label: Create Plaintext Block
nodes.title: Plaintext Content Block Factory
nodes.description: Generates a 'PlainTextContentBlock' from text, URL, base64 data, or file ID, with optional title and context.

nodes.label: Create Reasoning Block
nodes.title: Reasoning Content Block Factory
nodes.description: Generates a 'ReasoningContentBlock' to represent an AI's thought process or internal reasoning.

nodes.label: Create Non-Standard Block
nodes.title: Non-Standard Content Block Factory
nodes.description: Generates a 'NonStandardContentBlock' to encapsulate provider-specific content that doesn't fit standard types.

nodes.label: Approximate Token Count
nodes.title: Message Token Counter
nodes.description: Provides an approximate token count for a sequence of messages.

nodes.label: Wrap Function as Runnable
nodes.title: Runnable Wrapper
nodes.description: Wraps a given function to make it compatible with the LangChain Runnable interface, allowing it to be part of a chain.

nodes.label: Merge Message Runs
nodes.title: Consecutive Message Merger
nodes.description: Combines consecutive messages of the same type into a single message, useful for consolidating chat history or streaming outputs.

nodes.label: Filter Messages
nodes.title: Message Filter
nodes.description: Filters a list of messages based on various criteria such as name, type, ID, or tool call IDs.

nodes.label: Truncate Last Messages
nodes.title: Token-Based Message Truncation
nodes.description: Truncates messages from the end of a sequence to fit within a specified token limit, optionally preserving system messages.

nodes.label: Chat Prompt Value
nodes.title: Concrete Chat Prompt Value
nodes.description: A concrete representation of a chat prompt value, explicitly listing the types of messages it accepts, used for external schemas.

groups.label: Translator Registration
groups.title: Translator Registration
groups.description: Manages the registration of all message block translators for various LLM providers.

groups.label: Anthropic Message Translation
groups.title: Anthropic Message Translation
groups.description: Handles the conversion of Anthropic-specific AI messages and chunks into a standardized LangChain content block format.

groups.label: Bedrock Message Translation
groups.title: Bedrock Message Translation
groups.description: Manages the translation of Bedrock AI messages and chunks, including Bedrock Converse specific formats, into LangChain content blocks.

groups.label: Google GenAI Message Translation
groups.title: Google GenAI Message Translation
groups.description: Provides functions to translate Google GenAI messages and chunks into the standard LangChain content block format.

groups.label: Groq Message Translation
groups.title: Groq Message Translation
groups.description: Facilitates the conversion of Groq AI messages and chunks into LangChain's standardized content block representation.

groups.label: OpenAI Message Translation
groups.title: OpenAI Message Translation
groups.description: Manages the translation of OpenAI AI messages and chunks, including specific chat completions input formats, into LangChain content blocks.

groups.label: Basic Content Block Factories
groups.title: Basic Content Block Factories
groups.description: Functions for creating fundamental content blocks like text, plaintext, reasoning, and generic non-standard blocks.

groups.label: Media Content Block Factories
groups.title: Media Content Block Factories
groups.description: Functions for creating content blocks representing various media types such as images, videos, audio, and general files.

groups.label: Message Utility Operations
groups.title: Message Utility Operations
groups.description: Provides utility functions for common message manipulations, including token counting, merging, filtering, and truncation.

groups.label: Message Data Structures
groups.title: Message Data Structures
groups.description: Defines concrete data structures for representing chat prompt values.
